top_news.title: NCP-ArchPreview Technical Report: Moving towards Latent Space Language Models through Next Concept Prediction
top_news.dek: NCP-ArchPreview introduces Next Concept Prediction to improve language model pretraining by learning discrete concepts alongside standard token prediction.
top_news.brief: The Intern-NCP team released a technical report on NCP-ArchPreview, a latent-space language model. It combines standard next-token prediction with a concept-level objective, forcing the model to learn discrete concepts that span multiple tokens. This approach aims to enhance structural understanding while maintaining autoregressive generation capabilities.
top_news.image_alt: Conceptual diagram of latent space language model architecture

top_news.title: Litelm: LiteLLM Without the Bloat
top_news.dek: Litelm is a lightweight alternative to the LiteLLM library designed for simpler LLM API abstraction.
top_news.brief: Litelm provides a stripped-down implementation for developers who need to interface with various LLM APIs without the overhead associated with the larger LiteLLM package. It focuses on core functionality for API requests.
top_news.image_alt: Litelm project badges showing PyPI version and test status

top_news.title: Rapidly scaling online storage to serve over 1 billion ChatGPT users
top_news.dek: OpenAI details the evolution of Habitat, its globally distributed storage platform serving over 1 billion users.
top_news.brief: Habitat has scaled from a simple Python library to a robust storage system handling 70 million requests per second across 40 regions. It is critical for maintaining low-latency data access for ChatGPT and other OpenAI products.

top_news.title: How hackers used Claude for missiles, drone swarms, and surveillance, while Chinese labs mined it for training data
top_news.dek: Anthropic's threat report reveals widespread abuse of Claude for military applications and large-scale data mining by Chinese AI labs.
top_news.brief: The report documents misuse ranging from missile software development to autonomous drone swarms. Additionally, labs like Alibaba's Qwen team have used Claude for massive data extraction, highlighting how AI lowers the barrier for sophisticated cyber operations.

top_news.title: Retrospectively Reverse-Engineering Apple's Neural Engine
top_news.dek: A developer shares insights from reverse-engineering Apple's Neural Engine, concluding the hardware is too specialized for general-purpose use.
top_news.brief: After three years of work on an ANE driver, the author found the architecture too opinionated to support diverse workloads. The project highlights the limitations of Apple's proprietary silicon for non-native tasks beyond specific macOS features.
top_news.image_alt: Technical diagram of Apple Neural Engine architecture

primary.title: Reduce LLM latency with prefix-aware routing on Amazon SageMaker Inference

In benchmarks on Llama 3.1 70B, it reduced P50 time-to-first-token by up to 77% and raised KV cache hit rates from about 25% to over 80%.
